# Harshad Satra

> Harshad Satra is a freelance web developer based in Mumbai, India, with 13 years of experience (since 2013) building fast, SEO-friendly and accessible websites, e-commerce stores, SaaS front ends and AI-driven web experiences. Core stack: Vue.js, Nuxt.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Directus, GSAP; deployments on AWS, Vercel, DigitalOcean and Netlify. Available for freelance projects worldwide.

## Services

- AI-powered web solutions (chatbots, AI search, automation)
- Custom websites and web apps (Vue.js, Nuxt.js, React, Next.js)
- E-commerce (WordPress/WooCommerce, Shopify Online Store 2.0)
- SaaS front-end architecture and dashboards
- Performance, technical SEO and accessibility audits and fixes
